{
  "analysis": "QEMU 8.2.2 with the 5.2.0 SeaBIOS still results in a stuck CPU at EIP=0x5f1. The QEMU 5.2.0 binary can't run due to Rosetta. We need to try different approaches: disassemble the stuck CPU to understand what it's doing, try `qemu-system-x86_64` instead, try strace on QEMU 5.2.0, and potentially rebuild QEMU 5.2.0 without PIE.",
  "plan": "First, disassemble the code at the stuck EIP to understand what the CPU is doing. Then try `qemu-system-x86_64` from apt. Also strace QEMU 5.2.0 to see exactly what syscall fails, and try rebuilding with `--disable-pie`.",
  "commands": [
    {
      "keystrokes": "python3 << 'EOF'
import socket, time
s = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
s.connect("/tmp/qemu-monitor.sock")
time.sleep(0.3)
s.recv(4096)
# CS base is 0x10710, EIP is 0x5f1, so linear address is 0x10D01
s.send(b"xp /20i 0x10d01\n")
time.sleep(1)
print(s.recv(8192).decode())
s.close()
EOF

",
